definitions: To become familiar with something so that it no longer seems new or difficult.
To adapt to a new situation, environment, or routine.
examples: It takes time to get accustomed to a new city.
She quickly got accustomed to the early mornings.
You will get accustomed to the taste.
They are getting accustomed to the colder weather.
pastTenses: got accustomed to, gotten accustomed to
